insights.message: 15 working sets at 63 base points, every lift inside its rep range.
New season best on Triceps Pushdown: 36.7 kg estimated 1RM.
Overhead press 47.5 kg × 8 while cutting is a good sign: strength is holding as the weight comes down.
4 weeks in a row at your 3-session target. Keep Monday's Pull session and the streak keeps growing.

note.headline: 4 of 3 sessions done; the scale barely moved, the trend is still down

insights.message: Pull, Legs, Push, Pull: all three sessions of the split, on schedule.
29,090 kg of working volume. Loads held or went up while you are eating under maintenance.
Body weight from 79.2 to 78.9 kg (-0.3 kg). One flat week is water and salt; judge the cut on the 4-week trend.
Food logged on 6 of 7 days. Logging the missing days too gives next week's review a complete picture.

note.headline: Protein on point, calories close to target

insights.message: 1973 kcal against a 1900 kcal rest-day target: a little over, which the lighter days this week make up for.
184 g protein of 170 g, spread over 4 meals. Protein at every meal is what keeps the muscle while the weight drops.
Carbs 177 g and fat 54 g. Put most of the rice and pasta around training to fuel the sessions.
1.25 L of water logged. Aim for the full 3.0 L, more on training days.
